LZMA SDK (LZMA / LZMA2 decoder)
===============================

What is here (unmodified)
  LzmaDec.c  LzmaDec.h  Lzma2Dec.c  Lzma2Dec.h  7zTypes.h  Compiler.h  Precomp.h

Where it comes from
  LZMA SDK 19.00 by Igor Pavlov (https://www.7-zip.org/sdk.html), public domain ("Igor Pavlov : Public domain" in each file).
  These seven files were copied byte for byte from the copy that mGBA 0.10.5 bundles (src/third-party/lzma), which RetroHub's
  build already downloads for the mgba_link core. SHA-256 of each file:
    cba4277d8cda4954ddb4ad1e2d91a3c119b27d6bde8e906c674f3532511c26f0  7zTypes.h
    432fffe11231783e452fa0d7bbfc0412d6860e377291e00d54e0fdf01b029878  Compiler.h
    10dc95c06e919cbcc4e2d5ef96ffb33d5e6148c918ccb7fcaa6ad106616275b7  Lzma2Dec.c
    53962ba2efbfe617b2feebd747bc84d544aa33ba84036253b484c945dd834bd4  Lzma2Dec.h
    34081b2f00685c1e2f0b4828cbdfebca846e0f7af82d7a84d38787824909e8f4  LzmaDec.c
    f43c4023065b3fc6c230c309457645070cecef848e8a3a1c9c4e0aa54eb5c5ff  LzmaDec.h
    3850ffe13cb2207dba1c037fe41a803303883aaeec1407052f6038c4e6722ace  Precomp.h
  LICENSE is the SDK's public-domain dedication (text taken from the copy libchdr bundles).

Why a second copy
  libchdr (already linked) bundles only LzmaDec, with its symbols renamed to CHDR_*, and without the LZMA2 chunk decoder.
  xdelta3's "-S lzma" secondary compression is an xz stream of LZMA2 chunks, so Lzma2Dec is needed. This copy keeps the
  original symbol names; the two copies cannot clash because libchdr's are prefixed.

Use
  src/common/patcher_vcdiff.cpp (class XzStream) parses the xz stream and block headers and drives Lzma2Dec_DecodeToBuf.
  Nothing in here is modified, so it can be replaced by a newer SDK release by dropping in the same file names.
